    if attacker_color == 'w':
        pawn_attacks = [( -1, -1 ), (1, -1 )]
    else:
        pawn_attacks = [( -1, 1 ), (1, 1 )]
    for dc, dr in pawn_attacks:
        pc = target[0] + dc
        pr = target[1] + dr
        if 0 <= pc < 8 and 0 <= pr < 8:
            sq = sq_from_coords(pc,pr)
            piece = board.get(sq)
            if piece and piece[0] == attacker_color and piece[1] == 'P':

    # Knights

        pc = target[0] + dc
        pr = target[1] + dr
        if 0 <= pc < 8 and 0 <= pr < 8:
            piece = board.get(sq_from_coords(pc,pr))
            if piece and piece[0] == attacker_color and piece[1] == 'N':
                return True

    # Bishops and queens (diagonal)
    for dc, dr in [(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)]:
        pc = target[0] + dc
        pr = target[1] + dr
        while 0 <= pc < 8 and 0 <= pr < 8:

            if piece:
                if piece[0] == attacker_color and piece[1] in ('B','Q'):

            pc += dc

    # Rooks and queens (orthogonal)
    for dc, dr in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:

    # King
